unit.explanation: Accuracy is assessed for 11 treatment-naive patients receiving their first-line regimen.

platform.explanation: Predictions came from patient-derived pancreatic cancer organoid pharmacotyping.

readout.explanation: Single-agent viability dose-response curves were summarized as AUC and converted into regimen predictions.

direction.explanation: The lowest AUC was defined as high responder and the highest AUC as low responder.

threshold_rule.explanation: Jenks Natural Breaks classified each drug into high, intermediate, or low responder categories used by the prediction score.

threshold_timing.explanation: The source describes Jenks clustering but does not establish a separately prespecified cutoff timing for this 11-patient evaluation.

patient_mapping.explanation: Figure 3B is described as showing individual treatment-naive PDO samples, regimens, therapy lines, and responses, but the parsed workspace lacks its row-level transcription.

regimen_match.explanation: The in vitro prediction was compared with the patient response to the administered FOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel first-line regimen.

n_units.explanation: The first-line treatment-naive comparison included 11 patients.

split.explanation: The simplified prediction score was applied to the same treatment-naive cohort used for the clinical correlation.

headline.blocked_reason: Missing independently transcribed row-level evidence from Figure 3B: each of the 11 patients needs an identifiable PDO regimen prediction and RECIST clinical response. Parsed tables provide only the aggregate statement that 10 of 11 predictions matched.

notes: The article states both "10 out of 11" and "91.1%"; 10/11 equals 0.9090909091 (90.909%), matching the requested target.
Clinical tumor control was CR, PR, or SD; PD was no control, per article:p20.
